Teams Commands: 
/teamsmod create <name> : creates team with the name <name>
/teamsmod list : lists all created teams
/teamsmod info <name> : lists all players in the team with name <name>
/teamsmod player <name> : prints the team of the player with name <name>
/teamsmod invite <name> : invites player with name <name> to your team
/teamsmod accept : accepts invitation to team
/teamsmod kick <name> : kicks player with name <name> from your team
/teamsmod leave : leaves your team
/teamsmod remove <name> : ADMIN ONLY - deletes the team with name <name>
